title: Pagonia Land Paker GdBin Info Report
description: JSON report emitted by `pagonia-paker gdbin info --json <path> <gdbin>`. Describes the decoded contents of a Pioneers of Pagonia `<modulename>.gd.bin` index file: its seven-byte header, the list of in-pak `*.gd.xml` paths it lists, and any diagnostics from parsing.

Gdbin.description: Path to the .gd.bin file the report describes.

Success.description: True when the file parsed cleanly. On false, see Diagnostics for the parse error.

EntryCount.description: Number of *.gd.xml entries enumerated in the index.

HeaderBytesHex.description: The seven-byte format header, preserved verbatim as hex strings (`0xNN`). Byte[3] is empirically `entries.Count - 1` across shipped indexes; the others are constants except for byte[1] which is `0x01` on tools.pak and `0x00` elsewhere.

Entries.description: In-pak paths of every *.gd.xml file the module contributes to the GameDatabase. Order matches the on-disk order in the .gd.bin.
